prompt: I am moving to the G40 postcode area - what train stations are nearby, as of 2024?
answer:
The **G40 postcode district covers Bridgeton, Dalmarnock and parts of Calton**, so the nearest station depends on the exact postcode. As a guide, the main nearby **ScotRail stations in 2024** were:

| Station | Approximate distance from G40 | Main services/notes |
|---|---:|---|
| **Bridgeton** | **0.2–0.6 miles** | Usually the closest station for Bridgeton and central G40; Argyle Line |
| **Dalmarnock** | **0.1–0.7 miles** | Closest for much of G40 4; Argyle Line |
| **Bellgrove** | **0.6–1.0 miles** | North Clyde Line and other local services |
| **High Street (Glasgow)** | **0.7–1.2 miles** | Convenient for Calton/eastern city centre; North Clyde and Argyle routes |
| **Argyle Street** | **about 0.9–1.3 miles** | Central Glasgow, mainly Argyle Line services |
| **Duke Street** | **about 1.0–1.4 miles** | North Clyde Line |
| **Glasgow Queen Street** | **about 1.1–1.7 miles** | Major station for North Clyde, Croy, Cumbernauld and other routes |
| **Glasgow Central** | **roughly 1.2–1.7 miles** | Glasgow’s principal long-distance and regional station |
| **Rutherglen** | **around 1.5–2 miles** | Useful for services south and east of Glasgow |

In practical terms, **Bridgeton and Dalmarnock are the two closest stations**. Bridgeton is generally nearest to the western and central parts of G40, while Dalmarnock is particularly convenient for addresses around **G40 4** and the east side of the district. Distances vary because G40 is a postcode district rather than one single location.
